decisionRules: Free note publications never replace paid publication debt or the paid 5/day strict floor.
Paid debt does not stop free manuscript production or the 2/day initial free experiment.
At 24h/72h/7d, compare free articles only on equal post-publication windows when data exists.
Above-median free engagement or meaningful related-paid click/purchase evidence promotes a theme to paid deep-dive priority.
Any paid theme with observed sales receives adjacent free search-intent satellites.
If free traffic exists but paid movement does not, test CTA/value proposition before producing more paid derivatives.
If neither traffic nor engagement appears, deprioritize instead of cloning the theme.
No cosmetic Store clones, no name-only article clones, and no invented sales/PV/conversion data.
